corrections.caveats: Enricher: the benchmark runs syncAwait with no executor, so collectAllPara runs its children serially on the calling thread (Lazy.md calls this usage wrong); how folly's collectAllRange dispatches under blockingWait was not checked. The numbers predate 1.4 (2025-07-29, cancellation), whose collectAll adds a Signal and one heap LazyLocalBase per child; not re-measured. Open issue #404: stack overflow without an executor.

Enricher: 'IO Thrpt' is the subject's net_recv_avg (ingest) per bin/compare; filters run at ingest, so parse speed is real but delivery is unmeasured. The harness config sets no Mem_Buf_Limit, so buffering is unbounded (matching the 584.5 MiB peak); sent/received 1.6 GiB/1.2 GiB against Vector's 2 GiB/804.8 MiB suggests a backlog at the end of the run (derived from page data, unconfirmed). compare averages all runs of the latest version (run count not shown), not single runs. The 3.2.x line is end of life; critical advisories GHSA-5rjf-prwh-pp7q (2024) and GHSA-jrp8-r9hx-gf73 (2026).
